newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria forex reserves fall to $506 mln Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria forex reserves fall to $506 mln Sept 30.

text.p: Bulgaria's foreign exchange reserves fell to $506.3 million in September from $575 million in August, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.
BNB FX RESERVES, SEPT AUG SEPT'95
"Reserves declined due to interest and principal payments on Bulgaria's foreign debt in September," a BNB statement said.
BNB officials were not immediately available for comment.
Next year Bulgaria has to meet some $1.5 billion foreign debt payments.
This month the IMF postponed for a second time a much needed second $115 million tranche of funding intil Bulgaria meets structural reform targets and closes down loss-makers.
Finance Minister Dimitar Kostov said recently that it was important to win external funding by the year-end as the next some $130 million coupon payments on Bulgarian Brady Bonds is due end-January.

Bulgaria, battered by an economic crisis, pledged to seek to increase its forex reserves to $1.3 billion by the end of the year under the funding agreement with the IMF signed in July. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
